lvl1_intro.speaker: TIGER
lvl1_intro.tanglish: Viji pakkathula irukka... Arjun vishayam avalukku theriya koodathu. Dileep-oda 4 bike aalungala silent-ah mudikanum.
lvl1_intro.english: Viji is shopping right around the corner... She must never know the truth about Arjun. Take out Dileep's 4 bike scouts dead silent.

lvl1_viji_warning.speaker: VIJI
lvl1_viji_warning.tanglish: Ennanga! Kaila enna Pollachi coconut-u? Rithu school street-la vambu ethuvum pannalayae?
lvl1_viji_warning.english: Hey! What's that Pollachi coconut in your hand? You better not be picking street fights near Rithu's school!

lvl1_viji_distracted.speaker: VIJI
lvl1_viji_distracted.tanglish: Kovil mani adikkudhu... Naan pooja pakkam paathutu varaen, neenga kaaikari bag-ah paarunga!
lvl1_viji_distracted.english: The temple bell is ringing... I'll check the shrine stall, you watch the vegetable bag!

lvl1_hold_fire.speaker: VIMAL
lvl1_hold_fire.tanglish: Thalaiva! Viji anni neraa crossing-ah paakuraanga! Snipers hold fire — [Q] அழுத்தி Temple Bell அடிச்சு திசை திருப்புங்க!
lvl1_hold_fire.english: Boss! Viji is looking straight at the crossing! Snipers are holding fire — press [Q] to ring the Temple Bell and turn her gaze!

lvl1_rickshaw_ready.speaker: VIMAL
lvl1_rickshaw_ready.tanglish: Thalaiva! Bajaj auto handbrake loose-ah thaan irukku. Coconut thattu thattuna 4 bikers-um Sivakasi cracker cart-la flat-u!
lvl1_rickshaw_ready.english: Boss! The Bajaj rickshaw handbrake is loose. One coconut tap and all 4 bikers crash straight into the Sivakasi fireworks cart!

lvl1_spec_flip.speaker: TIGER
lvl1_spec_flip.tanglish: Amaithiya Irukkurathu Bayam Illa... Athu En Style. HUKUM!
lvl1_spec_flip.english: Staying quiet isn't out of fear... It's just my style. THE VERDICT IS MINE!

lvl1_victory.speaker: TIGER
lvl1_victory.tanglish: Viji vandhutta... Coconuts ellam correct bag-la pottachu. Rithu-va school-la irundhu kooptu polama?
lvl1_victory.english: Viji's here... All the coconuts are safely in the grocery bag. Shall we pick up Rithu from school and head home?

lvl2_intro.speaker: VIMAL
lvl2_intro.tanglish: Aiyayyo Thalaiva! 6 black SUV-la weapon-oda narrow bridge-ah block pannitaanunga! Namma Premier Padmini taxi-ah reverse eduthudava? Moorthy vera anga phone pesa poyitaaru!
lvl2_intro.english: Oh god Boss! 6 armored black SUVs with weapons have blocked this narrow bridge! Should I reverse our Premier Padmini taxi? Moorthy has run off to make calls!

lvl2_tiger_cue.speaker: TIGER
lvl2_tiger_cue.tanglish: Vimal... Bayapadaama kitta vaa. Shirt pocket-la irukkura en kannadi-ah maatti rendu vaati aatturaen... Nalla paaru.
lvl2_tiger_cue.english: Vimal... don't panic, stand right beside me. I'm putting on the aviators from my shirt pocket and shaking them twice... Watch closely.

lvl2_shake_specs.speaker: TIGER
lvl2_shake_specs.tanglish: Oru shake... Rendaavathu shake... Kannadi rendu vaati asanjaa, Hilltop Snipers — Execute Protocol HUKUM!
lvl2_shake_specs.english: One shake... Second shake... When the glasses shake twice, Hilltop Snipers — Execute Protocol HUKUM!

lvl2_vimal_shock.speaker: VIMAL
lvl2_vimal_shock.tanglish: Ammaadii! Ennathu?! Kannadi-ah rendu thadava asachaa 6 SUV-um river-la blast aagiduchu! Golden car key neeraa en kayila vandhu vizhudhu!
lvl2_vimal_shock.english: Good lord! What on earth?! He just shook his glasses twice and all 6 SUVs blew up into the river gorge! The golden SUV key landed right in my hands!

lvl2_victory.speaker: MOORTHY
lvl2_victory.tanglish: Paathiya Tiger! Oru phone call, anju nimisham... En pera ketta udane 6 SUV-um aaththula kudhichitanunga! Moorthy Sir power purinjatha?
lvl2_victory.english: See that Tiger! One phone call, five minutes... The moment they heard my name, all 6 SUVs jumped into the river! Did you grasp Moorthy Sir's power?

lvl3_intro.speaker: TIGER
lvl3_intro.tanglish: Thambi... Mukund anuppuna 12 pera? En meter tea innum varala, aana kettle whistle adikkumbodhu unga aalunga kilambiduvaanga.
lvl3_intro.english: Bro... Did tracker Mukund send all 12 of you? My meter tea hasn't even arrived yet, and when that kettle whistles your boys will leave the planet.

lvl3_spec_flip.speaker: TIGER
lvl3_spec_flip.tanglish: Oru Sun, Oru Moon... Puriyutha? Tihar-la irundhu Palakkad varaikkum ore oru Tiger dhaan. HUKUM!
lvl3_spec_flip.english: One Sun, One Moon... Do you get the hierarchy? From Tihar Jail to Palakkad, there is only one Tiger. HUKUM!

lvl3_victory.speaker: TIGER
lvl3_victory.tanglish: Tea nalla strong-ah irukku thambi. Vimal, vandiya edu... Kochi Port-la Chola idol containers-ah thookanum!
lvl3_victory.english: The tea is nice and strong, brother. Vimal, start the taxi... We have 3 Chola idol containers to intercept at Kochi Port!

lvl4_intro.speaker: DILEEP
lvl4_intro.tanglish: Tiger Muthuvel Pandian! Varman-ah mudichathu nee dhaan-nu therinjiduchu! Indha Kochi container yard-la unna uyiroda vida maatten!
lvl4_intro.english: Tiger Muthuvel Pandian! I know you're the one who finished Varman! I won't let you leave this Kochi container yard alive!

lvl4_spec_flip.speaker: TIGER
lvl4_spec_flip.tanglish: 24 mani nerathula alapara kelapparom! Mathew, magnetic crane-ah irakki Dileep jeep-ah Madagascar kappal-la ஏத்து! HUKUM!
lvl4_spec_flip.english: In 24 hours we unleash total mayhem! Mathew, drop the magnetic crane and hoist Dileep's jeep onto the Madagascar cargo ship! HUKUM!

lvl4_victory.speaker: MATHEW
lvl4_victory.tanglish: Pakshe Tiger, ivide nammude vintage Mercedes barricades ellam thool-aakki! 3 idol containers-um namma kitta... Goa polam!
lvl4_victory.english: My friend Tiger, our vintage Mercedes turned their port barricades to dust! All 3 idol containers are ours... Onward to Goa!

lvl5_intro.speaker: KANTHA
lvl5_intro.tanglish: Welcome to Goa, Jailer Muthuvel Pandian. Tea-ya, Coffee-ya? Enga Kalpak estate-la neenga enna kudikkanum-nu naanga dhaan decide pannuvom.
lvl5_intro.english: Welcome to Goa, Jailer Muthuvel Pandian. Tea or Coffee? In our Kalpak estate, we decide which sip will be your last.

lvl5_spec_flip.speaker: TIGER
lvl5_spec_flip.tanglish: Tea-ya, Coffee-ya? Neenga decide panna mudiyathu Kantha Madam... En sniper laser teapot-la pattu chandelier vizhumbodhu puriyum. HUKUM!
lvl5_spec_flip.english: Tea or Coffee? You don't get to decide, Madam Kantha... You'll understand when my sniper laser ricochets off that silver teapot and drops the chandelier. HUKUM!

lvl5_victory.speaker: TIGER
lvl5_victory.tanglish: Unga poison tea unga lieutenants-ke kuduthachu. Goa Syndicate ledger en pocket-la... Varataa?
lvl5_victory.english: Your poisoned tea has been served to your own lieutenants. The Goa Syndicate ledger is in my pocket... Shall I take my leave?

lvl6_intro.speaker: BODHI
lvl6_intro.tanglish: Hello Mic Testing 1-2-3! Enna Muthuvel Sir, Tihar Jailer mattum thaan sniper vaippana? En 8 green-laser counter-snipers-ah paaru!
lvl6_intro.english: Hello Mic Testing 1-2-3! What's the matter Muthuvel Sir, does only the Tihar Jailer have a monopoly on snipers? Feast your eyes on my 8 green-laser counter-snipers!

lvl6_spec_flip.speaker: TIGER
lvl6_spec_flip.tanglish: Vimal, namma taxi bonnet-ah thiruppu... Bodhi-oda green laser avan fireworks truck melaye thirumbi vizhattum! HUKUM!
lvl6_spec_flip.english: Vimal, angle our chrome taxi hood... Let Bodhi's green lasers bounce straight back into his own firework trucks! HUKUM!

lvl6_victory.speaker: VIMAL
lvl6_victory.tanglish: Thalaiva! Bodhi megaphone-oda carnival ferris wheel-la thongitu kathuraan! Namma Padmini bonnet mirror maadhiri velai senjiduchu!
lvl6_victory.english: Boss! Bodhi is dangling from the carnival Ferris wheel screaming into his megaphone! Our Padmini hood worked like a precision mirror!

lvl7_intro.speaker: NARASIMHA
lvl7_intro.tanglish: Muthuvel Anna! En kudumbatha kaapathuna unakku uyirae kuduppaen! Ved, Sharva 3 breach van-oda safe house-ah suthitaanunga!
lvl7_intro.english: Brother Muthuvel! You saved my wife and son—I owe you my life! Ved and Sharva Kalpak have surrounded the Mysuru safe house with 3 armored breach vans!

lvl7_cameo_narasimha.speaker: NARASIMHA
lvl7_cameo_narasimha.tanglish: Puli padhungurathu paayurathukku thaan! Naan ulla vandhutaen... Yaarukkum ini thappikka vazhi illa!
lvl7_cameo_narasimha.english: The Tiger crouches only to pounce harder! I have entered the arena... There is no exit for anyone alive!

lvl7_cameo_mathew.speaker: MATHEW
lvl7_cameo_mathew.tanglish: Ivide oru vintage Mercedes vandhaal... Kalpak breach vans ellam thool-aakum!
lvl7_cameo_mathew.english: When this vintage W123 Mercedes rolls in... the Kalpak breach vans turn to dust!

lvl7_victory.speaker: TIGER
lvl7_victory.tanglish: Narasimha, Mathew... Moonu perum serndha entha cartel-um nikkathu. Adutha stop: Chakri Kalpak-oda Casino Cruise!
lvl7_victory.english: Narasimha, Mathew... When the three of us stand together, no cartel on earth can survive. Next stop: Chakri Kalpak's Casino Cruise!

lvl8_intro.speaker: TIGER
lvl8_intro.tanglish: Chakri Kalpak... Tihar-la naan paatha velai vera, ippo un 'Bindaas' cruise ship-la paakura velai vera.
lvl8_intro.english: Chakri Kalpak... The job I retired from at Tihar was brutal, what I'm about to do on your 'Bindaas' cruise ship is far worse.

lvl8_spec_flip.speaker: TIGER
lvl8_spec_flip.tanglish: DJ bass drop aagumbodhu 3 idol vault-um vedikkattum! Vimal speedboat-la crates ellam parandhu vizhattum! HUKUM!
lvl8_spec_flip.english: Right when the DJ's bass drops, blow all 3 idol vaults wide open! Launch the crates straight onto Vimal's speedboat! HUKUM!

lvl8_victory.speaker: VIMAL
lvl8_victory.tanglish: Thalaiva! Party crowd innum dance aaditu irukkanunga, aana Chakri Kalpak-oda moththa vault-um namma speedboat-la!
lvl8_victory.english: Boss! The party crowd is still dancing to the beat, while Chakri Kalpak's entire war-chest is sitting in our speedboat!

lvl9_intro.speaker: TIGER
lvl9_intro.tanglish: 50 varushama enna azhikka paarthanga... Oru adi kooda pinnaadi eduthu vaikkama indha Goa runway-la nikkuraen. Vaanga da!
lvl9_intro.english: For 50 years, legends tried to finish me... I won't take a single step backward on this Goa runway. Come get some!

lvl9_spec_flip.speaker: RODDY
lvl9_spec_flip.tanglish: Tihar-la neenga en வாழ்க்கையை மாத்துனீங்க Jailer Sir! Helicopter twin-SMGs locked on runway jeeps — HUKUM!
lvl9_spec_flip.english: You reformed my life in Tihar Prison, Jailer Sir! Helicopter twin-SMGs locked onto the runway jeeps — HUKUM!

lvl9_victory.speaker: TIGER
lvl9_victory.tanglish: Runway clear. Roddy, helicopter-ah Cabo de Rama cliff fortress pakkam thiruppu... Viji-yum Rithu-vum anga irukkaanga.
lvl9_victory.english: Runway clear. Roddy, bank the helicopter toward the Cabo de Rama cliff fortress... Viji and Rithu are being held at the penthouse.

lvl10_intro.speaker: CHAKRI
lvl10_intro.tanglish: Muthuvel Pandian! Un pondatti Viji-kku Arjun-ah konnathu nee dhaan-nu therinjiduchu! Innum enna dhairiyathula en helipad-la nikkura?
lvl10_intro.english: Muthuvel Pandian! Your wife Viji now knows you ordered Arjun's execution! By what audacity do you still stand on my fortress helipad?

lvl10_finale.speaker: TIGER
lvl10_finale.tanglish: Thappu senja petha paiyana irundhaalum thandanai undu... Adhu dhaan Tiger Dharma! HUKUM... TIGER KA HUKUM! 10 Snipers Ready... FIRE!
lvl10_finale.english: Even if it is my own flesh and blood who turns corrupt, justice spares no one... That is Tiger's Dharma! HUKUM... TIGER KA HUKUM! All 10 Snipers Ready... FIRE!

lvl10_victory.speaker: TIGER
lvl10_victory.tanglish: Kantha, Bodhi, Chakri... Moonu peraiyum Vimal-oda 'Prison Van' taxi dicky-la pottachu. Viji, Rithu... Veetukku polama?
lvl10_victory.english: Kantha, Bodhi, and Chakri... All three Kalpak bosses are locked inside Vimal's 'Prison Van' taxi. Viji, Rithu... Shall we go home?
